pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: You are advising a D2C (direct-to-consumer) e-commerce brand that wants to build a personalization engine to serve individualized product recommendations across email, on-site, and paid retargeting channels. Their current stack has no unified customer identifier — email behavior, website sessions, and ad click data all sit in separate systems with no shared ID. They've heard that third-party cookie deprecation has made this problem worse, not better. They want to use a large language model to improve recommendation quality and also want to be able to measure the incremental revenue impact of personalization specifically, not just overall channel revenue. Walk me through how you would architect a solution to this, what you would recommend they build versus buy, and how you would design measurement that actually isolates the effect of personalization.
